messages:
jordan.white: Need urgent help. BetaCorp wants a 30% "show-on-quote" discount for procurement to approve POC purchase. CPQ enforces max 15% for self-serve accounts. Can we get an approval path? :pray: 

emily.chen: Hi Jordan 2020What's ARR / committed term? Any compliance notes (VPC/on-prem)?

jordan.white: ARR ~ $60k, committing 9 months now with option to extend. They also requested private tenancy discussion and SOC2 artifacts during procurement.

ravi.singh: 30% visible on quote is large. Two routes: (A) Pricing Ops fast override (Approval_Tier__c = Pricing_Ops) with sponsor + 24h SLA, but needs min 12-months normally. (B) VP Sales approval for exceptions under 12 months. Which sponsor do you have?

jordan.white: I can get VP sponsor on call but not before tomorrow morning. Procurement needs quote today. Any temp workaround?

emily.chen: Workaround: set `List_Price_Adjust__c` to 15% in CPQ and add a separate line item called "POC partner credit" with negative amount to reach net 30%. Finance flags that for revenue ops review and procurement will still see net price but it's in the quote. That avoids changing discount rules but triggers Finance review.

jordan.white: Procurement insisted discount must appear as single line discount, negative line items won't pass their SSO procurement tool.

tara.lewis: If procurement tool requires single-line discount, we must create an override token. I'll open a Deal Desk ticket and set Approval_Priority__c=urgent. Need sponsor email + LOI + SOC2 link. Also Legal requires a cost-recovery clause when discount >20% for POCs.

dealdesk-bot: Created ticket DD-2026-233. SLA: 24 hours (expedite). Attachments required: quote PDF, LOI, sponsor email, SOC2 link. Fields to set in SF quote: `Approval_Status__c=pending_dealdesk`, `Requested_Discount__c=30`, `Show_Discount_On_QT__c=true`.

legal-bot: Legal note: discount >20% triggers audit clause + upfront payment schedule recommended. CC @tara.lewis for clause drafting.

ravi.singh: Runbook update: For any "show_on_quote" >20% we require: sponsor email, procurement tool compatibility note, SOC/compliance artifacts if private tenancy mentioned, and finance signoff. Fast-path only if VP sponsor email present.

emily.chen: I'll coordinate with Finance on the negative-line rejection and confirm if procurement admits override tokens. If not, push for VP sponsor asap.

jordan.white: Uploading LOI and sponsor email to DD-2026-233 now. Adding comment in SF: `Approval_Notes__c=Procurement requires single-line discount; urgent.`

tara.lewis: I'll draft the legal carveout and include a clause that the special price applies for invoice 1 only and is subject to audit. Sending initial verbiage to the ticket.

dealdesk-bot: DD-2026-233 status -> `awaiting_approver_response`. SLA countdown started (24h).
